F=[[3]*20 for _ in range(20)]
# walls and closed 9 frame
for r in range(20): F[r][11]=9
for c in range(3,12): F[4][c]=9; F[10][c]=9
for r in range(4,11): F[r][3]=9; F[r][11]=9
# component mask: outside the closed frame on left
mask={(r,c) for r in range(20) for c in range(11) if F[r][c]!=9 and not (5<=r<=9 and 4<=c<=10)}
# Assign Chebyshev-depth layers by successive erosion of the exterior component
remaining=set(mask); depth={}; layer=0
while remaining:
    edge=set()
    for r,c in remaining:
        if any((r+dr,c+dc) not in remaining for dr in (-1,0,1) for dc in (-1,0,1)):
            edge.add((r,c))
    for pos in edge: depth[pos]=layer
    remaining-=edge; layer+=1
for r,c in mask: F[r][c]=7 if depth[(r,c)]%2==0 else 4
# enclosed room: one-color rings are uniformly 2
for r in range(5,10):
 for c in range(4,11): F[r][c]=2
# right region rings
for r in range(20):
 for c in range(12,20):
  d=min(r,19-r,c-12,19-c)
  F[r][c]=6 if d%2==0 else 7
print('layers',layer)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in F))
